fact: Decree 2024-2692 creates the computerised secure national identity card, issued to all Congolese aged 16 and over, carrying a national number.
system: Carte nationale d'identite informatisee et securisee

fact: The Finance Ministry says the NIU is issued to every foreign resident and Congolese citizen from age 6, valid 10 years, free for individuals.
source_slug: 2025-10-23 Congo relaunches NIU biometric unique-ID card production

fact: The NIU modernised in 2020 (order 5327) captures iris and fingerprints in physical presence, and Minister Christian Yoka frames it as curbing duplicates and fraud.
source_slug: 2025-10-23 Congo relaunches NIU biometric unique-ID card production

fact: Les Depeches de Brazzaville reports that 25,549 NIU (unique identification number) cards issued from 2020 to 2024 were uncollected in Pointe-Noire.
